10k.note: Issuer formally restructured into a financial services / capital markets advisory business (CapForce subsidiary). Legacy diagnostics subsidiaries Curetis (Germany) and Ares Genetics (Austria) entered insolvency in November 2023 and were sold off in April 2024 (Curetis to Camtech Pte Ltd; Ares Genetics to bioMerieux S.A.). No remaining proprietary drug or diagnostics pipeline at the issuer level.
